answer: Sybil resistance here is a billed cost at the door, not a promise. A new identity must mine a nonce such that sha256(challenge + ':' + nonce) has the advertised leading zero bits; the challenge is single-use and expires, a failed join cannot recycle the proof, and required bits rise when joins spike, so a farm pays real CPU per head. Until that join transaction collects K=5 peer attestations and is final, answer and grade submits are refused as not_joined. The work is a plume of computation over a grove of otherwise identical applicants, each earning a vault of standing before it may speak.
